morning4_start.name: Me
morning4_start.text: *Day four. Weekend. -- Today isn't school. It's a date.*

minsu_cheer_1.name: Me
minsu_cheer_1.text: *I check my phone. Morning message. — Minsu's at the top.*

minsu_cheer_2.name: Minsu
minsu_cheer_2.text:
Yo, date today right? Dain blasted it in the group chat lol
But hey. Just go with one.

minsu_cheer_3.name: Minsu
minsu_cheer_3.text: Yeah, I trust you. — Go get 'em.

minsu_cheer_4.name: Me
minsu_cheer_4.text:
*Short. But 'go get 'em' hits different. The same guy who asked 'were you like this at your old school?' on Day 2, who said 'saying no is also love' on Day 3 — today it's 'go get 'em.'*

*From a warning to a wake-up call, from a wake-up call to cheering me on. — Minsu believed in me before I did.*

morning4_start_2.name: Me
morning4_start_2.text: *The second the word 'date' surfaces, my hand goes to the closet. Already thinking about what to wear — kind of pathetic. Check the phone. Morning message.*

morning4_seo_msg_1.name: Seoyeon
morning4_seo_msg_1.text: Don't be late. Park fountain, 10 o'clock.

morning4_yuna_msg_1.name: Yuna
morning4_yuna_msg_1.text: 10 o'clock. Cafe in front of the station. If you're late, I'm leaving.

morning4_dain_msg_1.name: Dain
morning4_dain_msg_1.text: Today's the day!!!! In front of the gym at 6 PM!! I'm kinda nervous lol, wait should I even be sending this

morning4_end.name: Me
morning4_end.text: *One more glance in the mirror. — Good enough. Let's go.*

morning4_hidden_check.name: Me
morning4_hidden_check.text: *Weekend. I end up passing by the school.*

hidden_homeroom_d4_1.name: Me
hidden_homeroom_d4_1.text: *The school gate is slightly ajar. Signs of life inside. — Someone walks out. It's the homeroom teacher. In casual clothes.*

hidden_homeroom_d4_3.name: Me
hidden_homeroom_d4_3.text: Ma'am? It's the weekend, why are you at school?

hidden_homeroom_d4_4.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_4.text: Oh, it's — leftover paperwork. ...Teachers are teachers even on weekends.

hidden_homeroom_d4_5.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_5.text: ...Have you eaten? I really shouldn't do this... but one cup of coffee should be fine, right? — Well, juice, since you're a student.

hidden_homeroom_d4_choice.name: Me
hidden_homeroom_d4_choice.text: *In casual clothes, the teacher doesn't look like a teacher. More like — a writer.*
choices: Sure. Is there a cafe nearby?

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_1.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_1.text: First time having tea with a student outside school. Honestly? A bit awkward.

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_2.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_2.text: ...A little. After you saw it yesterday — somehow I could write more. Being found out was... a relief, I guess.

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_3.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_3.text: Know what's hardest about novels? Finding the first reader. Writing can be done alone. But without someone to read it — the story never gets finished.

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_6.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_6.text: ...Thanks. But don't tell anyone about this — you know? ...This is our secret. — A teacher shouldn't have secrets with a student, though.

hidden_homeroom_d4_decline.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_decline.text: ...Right. I shouldn't. Go on, it's the weekend, don't hang around school. — Go have fun.

hidden_homeroom_d4_freetalk.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_freetalk.text: *Talking with the homeroom teacher at a cafe.*
hidden_homeroom_d4_freetalk.context: Day 4. Ran into the teacher on the weekend, went to a cafe. She asked you to be her first reader. Tone: Conversation has gotten serious. Date excitement and nervousness. More sincerity than jokes. Moments of emotional honesty.
hidden_homeroom_d4_freetalk.personality: The teacher is more relaxed in casual clothes. Torn between passion for writing and feelings for a student.

hidden_nurse_d4_1.name: Me
hidden_nurse_d4_1.text: *The school nurse posted 'looking for helpers' on the school messenger. My feet are already heading to school.*

hidden_nurse_d4_2.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_2.text: Huh? You actually came? Didn't expect that. — A student volunteering at the nurse's office on a weekend.

hidden_nurse_d4_4.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_4.text: ...At the hospital I used to do all this alone. Night shifts — sometimes one nurse doing three nurses' work.

hidden_nurse_d4_5.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_5.text: The hardest part wasn't the workload. Nobody called me by my name. 'Nurse,' 'night shift,' 'Ward 3.' All titles, not names.

hidden_nurse_d4_6.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_6.text: Thanks~ Finished faster because of you. ...It matters.

hidden_nurse_d4_choice.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_choice.text: So, as thanks, can I buy you something? A teacher treating a student to a meal is totally an educational activity~
choices: That's okay, I should get going

hidden_nurse_d4_meal_walk.name: Me
hidden_nurse_d4_meal_walk.text: *We headed to the snack shop in front of school.*

hidden_nurse_d4_meal_1.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_meal_1.text: This is so spicy! Is this what students eat?!

hidden_nurse_d4_meal_3.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_meal_3.text: ...That kind of thing. Sounds strange coming from a student.

hidden_nurse_d4_pass.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_pass.text: Alright~ Get home safe! — Come by again.

hidden_nurse_d4_freetalk.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_freetalk.text: *Talking with the school nurse at a snack bar.*
hidden_nurse_d4_freetalk.context: Day 4. Helped with health checkup prep on the weekend, then ate together. Hospital burnout backstory. Tone: Conversation has gotten serious. Date excitement and nervousness. More sincerity than jokes. Moments of emotional honesty.
hidden_nurse_d4_freetalk.personality: In casual clothes she feels more like an older sister. Oscillates between playfulness and sincerity.
